name: codex-claude-desktop-bridge
description: Send native messages directly between Codex Desktop tasks and Claude Desktop Code sessions through MCP tools.

interface.shortDescription: Message Codex and Claude Desktop conversations.
interface.longDescription: Send text directly between any available Codex Desktop task and local Claude Desktop Code session. Either application can start a conversation or reply.
interface.defaultPrompt: Find the Claude Desktop Code conversation I name and send it my message.
